customMethods.script:
def getBinIndex(binList, binValue):
		k = binValue  
		closestValue = binList[min(range(len(binList)), key = lambda i: abs(binList[i]-k))] 
		binIndex = binList.index(closestValue)
		return binIndex	
	
	def getProcessCapabilityIndices(usl, lsl, mean, sigma):
	    cP = float(usl - lsl) / (6*sigma)	
	    cPU = float(usl - mean) / (3*sigma)
	    cPL = float(mean - lsl) / (3*sigma)
	    cPK = min([cPU, cPL])
	    return cP, cPK, cPU, cPL
	
	system.perspective.print("updateCalculatedFields() called")

	maxValue = system.math.max(valueList)
	minValue = system.math.min(valueList)
	meanValue = system.math.mean(valueList)
	sigma = system.math.standardDeviation(valueList)
	
	calcLCL = meanValue - (3*sigma)
	calcUCL = meanValue + (3*sigma)	
	sigma_3n = meanValue - (3*sigma)
	sigma_2n = meanValue - (2*sigma)
	sigma_1n = meanValue - (sigma)
	sigma_1p = meanValue + (sigma)
	sigma_2p = meanValue + (2*sigma)
	sigma_3p = meanValue + (3*sigma)	

	bar_lcl_data = [{"bin": calcLCL, "count": 0}, {"bin": calcLCL, "count": 1.2}]		
	bar_ucl_data = [{"bin": calcUCL, "count": 0}, {"bin": calcUCL, "count": 1.2}]	
	bar_tgt_data = [{"bin": tgt, "count": 0}, {"bin": tgt, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_mean_data = [{"bin": meanValue, "count": 0}, {"bin": meanValue, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_1p_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_1n_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_2p_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_2n_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_3p_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
	bar_sigma_3n_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 1.2}]
		
#	system.perspective.print(str(popDataList))
	if len(popDataList) > 0:
		binList = [key["bin"] for key in popDataList]
		binIndex = getBinIndex(binList, meanValue)
		count = popDataList[binIndex]["count"]

		bar_mean_data = [{"bin": meanValue, "count": 0}, {"bin": meanValue, "count": count}]
		binIndex = getBinIndex(binList, sigma_3n)
		count = popDataList[binIndex]["count"]
		bar_sigma_3n_data = [{"bin": sigma_3n, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_3n, "count": count}]
		bar_sigma_3p_data = [{"bin": sigma_3p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_3p, "count": count}]		
			
		binIndex = getBinIndex(binList, sigma_2n)
		count = popDataList[binIndex]["count"]	
		bar_sigma_2n_data = [{"bin": sigma_2n, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_2n, "count": count}]
		bar_sigma_2p_data = [{"bin": sigma_2p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_2p, "count": count}]
			
		binIndex = getBinIndex(binList, sigma_1n)
		count = popDataList[binIndex]["count"]	
		bar_sigma_1n_data = [{"bin": sigma_1n, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1n, "count": count}]
		bar_sigma_1p_data = [{"bin": sigma_1p, "count": 0}, {"bin": sigma_1p, "count": count}]	
		
	if lsl is None or usl is None: cP, cPK, cPU, cPL = None, None, None, None
	else: cP, cPK, cPU, cPL = getProcessCapabilityIndices(usl, lsl, meanValue, sigma)

	table_data = [{"Min":minValue, "Max":maxValue, "Mean":meanValue, "Std Dev.":sigma, "cP":cP, "cPK":cPK, "cPU":cPU, "cPL":cPL, "LSL":lsl, "LCL":calcLCL, "Target":tgt, "UCL":calcUCL, "USL":usl}]

	return table_data,bar_lcl_data,bar_ucl_data,bar_mean_data,bar_tgt_data,bar_sigma_1n_data,bar_sigma_1p_data,bar_sigma_2n_data,bar_sigma_2p_data,bar_sigma_3n_data,bar_sigma_3p_data
